workload: One dense image: 4 models x 800 boxes, one class, IoU 0.55; time spent inside find_matching_box_fast during weighted_boxes_fusion.
notes: Each call builds a fresh set of NumPy temporaries to score one box against the clusters kept so far, and fusion does that once per box. A numba loop in this function (numba is already a dependency) that returns only the best index reproduced the fused boxes on this input and cut the matcher from about 66 ms to about 10 ms. baseline_noise_pct is (max-min)/median*100 over 5 runs; GC was paused during the timed call.

workload: One oriented-detection image: 4 models x 100 rotated boxes, one class, IoU 0.55; time spent inside rotated_box_corners during fusion.
notes: The function builds several length-4 arrays and a 2x2 matmul for four corners, and fusion calls it for every pair that passes the circle test. Scalar trig plus one (4, 2) result array matched corners within 1e-16 and cut that call list from 23.6 ms to 8.2 ms. baseline_noise_pct is (max-min)/median*100 over 5 runs; GC was paused during the timed call.

workload: One scene-text image: 4 models x 150 jittered quadrangles, one class, IoU 0.55; time spent inside order_quadrangle during fusion.
notes: Ordering four vertices goes through NumPy mean, arctan2, argsort, and roll, and quadrangle fusion calls it on every kept box and every IoU pair. A scalar atan2 order matched 5100 real call outputs exactly and cut a replay of those calls from 60.7 ms to 13.6 ms. baseline_noise_pct is (max-min)/median*100 over 5 runs; GC was paused during the timed call.

workload: One dense image: 4 models x 800 boxes, one class; heap blocks allocated inside prefilter_boxes.
notes: Each kept box is stored as a Python list of freshly boxed floats, then copied into an array. The harness sums positive per-line increases of sys.getallocatedblocks inside prefilter_boxes (25437 on this image). A column-wise NumPy build of the same (N, 8) array matched values and allocated about 40 blocks. baseline_noise_pct is (max-min)/median*100; five runs returned the same count.
